name: R1-native-plus-deletion

rule.name: R1-native-plus-deletion
rule.source: highest-ranked nonempty native beam hypothesis text
rule.operation: split on whitespace; delete words[len(words)//2]; join remaining words with one space
rule.preserve: all remaining words, case and punctuation
rule.tokenization: same frozen public Whisper-small tokenizer encode
rule.empty_deletion_result: retain and score actual EOS probability
rule.deduplication: if token path already exists, add nothing and try no other deletion

scale: recalibrate once on same three clips; same finite/nonzero/median/bounds guards
caveat: The deletion is a synthetic counterfactual, not a posterior beam hypothesis; no novelty or preserved human audio-content claim follows.
stop: One repair only; any degeneracy stops it without another candidate or condition
